# `returning-arena-allocation`

<!-- rule-docs:header (generated by `zig build rule-docs`) -->
Tier: correctness · Profile: none · Default: warning · Fixes: none · Options: none

Reports a returned value allocated from a local arena that is deinitialized
before the function finishes returning.
<!-- /rule-docs:header -->

## Why it matters

Arena deinitialization invalidates every allocation made from it, so the
returned value immediately dangles.

## When it fires

It applies to locally created arenas with visible deferred deinitialization and
recognizable allocation provenance, including arena-owned values embedded in a
returned aggregate.

<!-- rule-docs:footer (generated by `zig build rule-docs`) -->
## Example

```zig
const std = @import("std");

fn build(gpa: std.mem.Allocator) ![]u8 {
    var arena = std.heap.ArenaAllocator.init(gpa);
    defer arena.deinit();
    return try arena.allocator().alloc(u8, 8);
}
```
